native-apps.title: Apps
native-apps.unavailableTool: This native app observation is unavailable.
native-apps.protectedArguments: The original call contains protected arguments.
native-apps.noArguments: The original call contains no arguments.
native-apps.nativeError: The native call reported an error. Private error details are not displayed.
native-apps.sessionOnly: Select apps for this original session. Changes apply to its next execution. Revocation blocks future calls; it does not prove cancellation or cleanup of an already admitted call. Discovery or installation does not grant permission to call tools.
native-apps.unsupported: Apps are unavailable for this session or its current Worker.
native-apps.invalid: The original Apps inventory or session receipt could not be verified. Read the current session again before changing selection.
native-apps.uncertain: An original Apps request is unresolved. Do not start another request or transfer its selection.
native-apps.empty: No named apps were reported by the original native inventory.
native-apps.stale: The session changed. Read Apps again before saving.
native-apps.saved: The original selection request was acknowledged. Read Apps to inspect the current selection and native availability.
